title: The Straight Line Is A Godless Line

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗马·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Almost without fail, an architectural draft starts with one straight line,
sentences.zh: 几乎毫无例外地，建筑图纸总是从一条直线开始，

sentences.en: and then another, and another.
sentences.zh: 然后是另一条，再另一条。

sentences.en: A succession of clean, orderly lines until eventually, a building emerges.
sentences.zh: 一连串整洁、有序的线条，直到最终，一栋建筑浮现出来。

sentences.en: And it makes sense that straight lines form the core of our built environment.
sentences.zh: 直线构成我们人造环境的核心，这是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: They're cost-efficient.
sentences.zh: 它们成本效益高。

sentences.en: Materials like wood and steel and pipes come in straight linear units,
sentences.zh: 木材、钢材和管道之类的材料都是直的线性单元，

sentences.en: although that's a bit of a tautology.
sentences.zh: 虽然这听起来有点像同义反复。

sentences.en: But it's certainly easier to calculate structural loads on rectilinear surfaces.
sentences.zh: 但在直线表面上计算结构荷载确实要容易得多。

sentences.en: Straight lines are logical, predictable.
sentences.zh: 直线符合逻辑，可以预测。

sentences.en: And they are completely devoid of humanity.
sentences.zh: 而且它们完全没有人情味。

sentences.en: So says producer Louisa Beck.
sentences.zh: 制作人路易莎·贝克如是说。

sentences.en: Actually, it's not my argument.
sentences.zh: 其实，这不是我的观点。

sentences.en: It's this guy's.
sentences.zh: 是这家伙的。

sentences.en: The straight line is godless and immoral.
sentences.zh: 直线是无神且不道德的。

sentences.en: The straight line is not a creative line, but an imitating line, a lying line, a coward line.
sentences.zh: 直线不是一条创造性的线条，而是一条模仿的线条、撒谎的线条、懦弱的线条。

sentences.en: This is Tausendsasser, Friedensreich, Regentag, Dunkelbund, Hundertwasser.
sentences.zh: 这就是陶森达瑟·弗里登斯赖希·雷根塔格·邓克尔邦德·亨德泽瓦。
zh_words: 达瑟·弗里登斯赖希·雷根塔格·邓克尔邦德·亨德

sentences.en: In German, that means multi-talented, peace-filled, rainy day, dark-colored hundred waters.
sentences.zh: 在德语里，这意味着多才多艺、充满和平、雨天、深色的百水。

sentences.en: It's a name he gave himself.
sentences.zh: 这是他给自己起的名字。

sentences.en: Yeah, no kidding.
sentences.zh: 是的，没开玩笑。

sentences.en: Which makes sense, because for Hundertwasser, radical self-expression was everything.
sentences.zh: 这很合情理，因为对亨德泽瓦来说，激进的自我表达就是一切。

sentences.en: Even tenant-owned buildings are subject to censorship.
sentences.zh: 即使是租户拥有的建筑物也要受到审查。

sentences.en: Such regulations are characteristic of prisons, cages, and stables.
sentences.zh: 这种规定是监狱、笼子和马厩的特征。

sentences.en: This is from a speech Hundertwasser gave in 1983 at the Architectural Association in London.
sentences.zh: 这是亨德泽瓦1983年在伦敦建筑协会发表演讲时说的话。

sentences.en: He was known for giving talks, wearing mismatched, wild-colored socks and wacky hats,
sentences.zh: 他以演讲闻名，总是穿着不搭调、颜色狂野的袜子和古怪的帽子，

sentences.en: or showing up completely naked.
sentences.zh: 或者赤身裸体地出现。

sentences.en: That day, though, he was fully clothed.
sentences.zh: 不过那天，他穿得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: He looked out into a room full of architects and told them they were criminals,
sentences.zh: 他看着满屋子的建筑师，告诉他们他们是罪犯，

sentences.en: planning lifeless, rigid structures that restricted human creativity.
sentences.zh: 在规划毫无生气、死板且限制人类创造力的结构。

sentences.en: The time has come for people to rebel against their confinement in cubicle constructions
sentences.zh: 人们反抗被关在小隔间建筑里的时代已经到来，

sentences.en: like prisoners or rabbits in cages.
sentences.zh: 就像笼子里的囚犯或兔子一样。

sentences.en: A confinement which is alien to human nature.
sentences.zh: 这种禁锢违背了人性。

sentences.en: Hundertwasser was born Friedrich Stowasser in 1928.
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦于1928年出生，原名弗里德里希·斯托瓦瑟。

sentences.en: He made a name for himself, so to speak, as a painter.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名画家可以说是一举成名。

sentences.en: He was known for squiggly, abstract, nearly psychedelic paintings.
sentences.zh: 他以曲折、抽象、近乎迷幻的画作而闻名。

sentences.en: And in 1985, he completed a building, an apartment complex in his home city of Vienna.
sentences.zh: 1985年，他在他的家乡维也纳完成了一座建筑，一个公寓综合体。

sentences.en: Hundertwasserhaus looks as if one of his paintings had been made manifeSt.
sentences.zh: 百水公寓看起来就像是他的某幅画变成了现实。

sentences.en: It's full of asymmetrical shapes, wacky colors, clashing patterns, mismatched windows,
sentences.zh: 它充满了不对称的形状、古怪的颜色、冲突的图案、不匹配的窗户，

sentences.en: and undulating, uneven floors.
sentences.zh: 以及起伏不平的地板。

sentences.en: There are no godless straight lines in sight.
sentences.zh: 放眼望去，看不到一条不敬神的直线。

sentences.en: Working together with architects and engineers,
sentences.zh: 与建筑师和工程师合作，

sentences.en: Hundertwasser went on to design more buildings all over Vienna.
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦接着在维也纳各地设计了更多的建筑。

sentences.en: His work really sticks out in that city.
sentences.zh: 他的作品在那座城市里非常显眼。

sentences.en: Almost all the other buildings there are stately baroque.
sentences.zh: 几乎那里的所有其他建筑都是庄严的巴洛克风格。

sentences.en: Throughout the 1980s and 90s,
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪80年代和90年代，

sentences.en: Hundertwasser went on to design all kinds of other structures,
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦继续设计各种其他结构，

sentences.en: like gas stations, heating plants, and schools.
sentences.zh: 比如加油站、供暖厂和学校。

sentences.en: And his renown extended beyond Vienna.
sentences.zh: 他的名声超出了维也纳。

sentences.en: He was hired to design buildings in Germany, Japan, New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 他被聘请在德国、日本、新西兰设计建筑。

sentences.en: He made one building in the U.S., a winery in Napa Valley.
sentences.zh: 他在美国建造了一座建筑，那是纳帕谷的一家酒庄。

sentences.en: His architecture is festooned with golden orbs and onion domes,
sentences.zh: 他的建筑上点缀着金色的圆球和洋葱顶，

sentences.en: zigzagging tiles, trees that grow out of apartment windows.
sentences.zh: 之字形的瓷砖，从公寓窗户里长出来的树。

sentences.en: He dreamed of creating indoor, moss-covered floors,
sentences.zh: 他梦想着创造室内长满青苔的地板，

sentences.en: though he was never able to get that approved.
sentences.zh: 虽然他从未能让这个想法获批。

sentences.en: I think you get it.
sentences.zh: 我想你懂的。

sentences.en: Hundertwasser designed some crazy-looking buildings.
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦设计了一些看起来很疯狂的建筑。

sentences.en: Many architectural circles dismiss Hundertwasser's work as kitsch.
sentences.zh: 许多建筑界人士将亨德泽瓦的作品斥为媚俗。

sentences.en: They look like buildings from Dr. Seuss or Pee-wee's Playhouse
sentences.zh: 它们看起来像苏斯博士或皮威游乐屋里的建筑，

sentences.en: or any number of children's cartoons.
sentences.zh: 或者任何数量的儿童动画片。

sentences.en: But Hundertwasser actually got them built.
sentences.zh: 但亨德泽瓦实际上把它们建造出来了。

sentences.en: And to him, they weren't just gimmicks.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，它们不仅仅是噱头。

sentences.en: Real people live in his buildings.
sentences.zh: 真实的人们居住在他的建筑里。

sentences.en: He was trying to reframe what the built environment can be,
sentences.zh: 他试图重新构想人造环境可以是什么，

sentences.en: to reimagine what architecture is supposed to do.
sentences.zh: 重新设想建筑应该做什么。

sentences.en: Today, architecture is criminally sterile.
sentences.zh: 如今，建筑单调得令人发指。

sentences.en: Today, architecture is criminally sterile, he says.
sentences.zh: 如今，建筑单调得令人发指，他说。

sentences.en: One of these Hundertwasser buildings stands in Magdeburg,
sentences.zh: 其中一座百水建筑坐落在马格德堡，

sentences.en: the city where I was born.
sentences.zh: 也就是我出生的城市。

sentences.en: Magdeburg is in what used to be communist East Germany,
sentences.zh: 马格德堡位于曾经的共产主义东德，

sentences.en: and it's one of those cities full of endless grids and straight lines.
sentences.zh: 它是那种充满无尽网格和直线的城市之一。

sentences.en: It's rows and rows of gray Soviet-style apartment blocks
sentences.zh: 那里有一排排灰色的苏联风格公寓楼

sentences.en: and post-war architecture,
sentences.zh: 和战后建筑，

sentences.en: until you walk onto the main street in the city center
sentences.zh: 直到你走到市中心的主街上，

sentences.en: and encounter this huge, eight-story-tall castle.
sentences.zh: 撞见这座巨大的、八层楼高的城堡。

sentences.en: And this castle is bright, bright pink.
sentences.zh: 这座城堡是亮粉色的，非常亮。

sentences.en: Salmon pink.
sentences.zh: 三文鱼粉色。

sentences.en: And it's decorated with brown-tiled squiggles,
sentences.zh: 它装饰着棕色瓷砖的曲折线条，

sentences.en: like big ceramic vines creeping up the pink walls.
sentences.zh: 就像巨大的陶瓷藤蔓在粉红色的墙壁上蔓延。

sentences.en: There are almost 900 windows of all different shapes and sizes,
sentences.zh: 这里有近900扇各种形状和大小的窗户，

sentences.en: and 150 different lollipop-looking columns hold up the building's floors.
sentences.zh: 150根看起来像棒棒糖的独特柱子支撑着建筑的楼层。

sentences.en: On the roof, eight golden spheres rise triumphantly,
sentences.zh: 屋顶上，八个金色的球体凯旋般地升起，

sentences.en: like suns over the dull, homogenous blocks around them.
sentences.zh: 就像周围沉闷、同质化的街区之上的太阳。

sentences.en: Parts of the roof slope all the way down to the street,
sentences.zh: 屋顶的一部分一直倾斜到街道，

sentences.en: and it's covered in trees.
sentences.zh: 上面长满了树木。

sentences.en: This is why, even though the building is mostly pink,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，尽管这座建筑主要是粉红色的，

sentences.en: it's called the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 它却被称为绿堡。

sentences.en: Residents of Magdeburg grappled with what to make
sentences.zh: 马格德堡的居民们努力揣摩

sentences.en: of this gigantic, tree-topped, salmon-pink castle.
sentences.zh: 这座巨大的、顶上有树的三文鱼粉色城堡到底该怎么看。

sentences.en: Everyone has different opinions about it,
sentences.zh: 每个人对它都有不同的看法，

sentences.en: including my grandparents,
sentences.zh: 包括我的祖父母，

sentences.en: who live about a 20-minute walk
sentences.zh: 他们住在离马格德堡绿堡

sentences.en: from the Green Citadel in Magdeburg.
sentences.zh: 步行约20分钟的地方。

sentences.en: I talked to them about it the last time I went back to visit.
sentences.zh: 我上次回去探亲时和他们谈过这件事。

sentences.en: My grandpa says he thinks it looks like a monkey house.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷说他觉得它看起来像个猴子房。

sentences.en: I asked him why, and he grunts about the colorful facade and wavy surface.
sentences.zh: 我问他为什么，他嘟囔着彩色外墙和波浪起伏的表面。

sentences.en: It just doesn't fit.
sentences.zh: 它就是不搭。

sentences.en: But my grandma, she likes it.
sentences.zh: 但我奶奶，她喜欢它。

sentences.en: In fact, she liked to live in it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她很乐意住在里面。

sentences.en: It breaks with the sameness that is so typical of East Germany.
sentences.zh: 它打破了东德极具代表性的千篇一律。

sentences.en: As my grandmother describes it,
sentences.zh: 正如我祖母所描述的，

sentences.en: quote,
sentences.zh: 引述如下：

sentences.en: For 40 communist years, we lived in the same concrete high-rises.
sentences.zh: 在共产主义的40年里，我们一直住在同样的混凝土高层公寓里。

sentences.en: And here is an apartment building that represents the uniqueness of each resident.
sentences.zh: 而这里是一座代表着每个居民独一无二性的公寓楼。

sentences.en: And Hundertwasser realized this.
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: In my opinion, she says,
sentences.zh: 依我看，她说，

sentences.en: there should be more buildings like it.
sentences.zh: 应该有更多这样的建筑。

sentences.en: Too bad he passed away.
sentences.zh: 可惜他去世了。

sentences.en: Plans for the Green Citadel began in 1996,
sentences.zh: 绿堡的计划始于1996年，

sentences.en: after the fall of the Berlin Wall.
sentences.zh: 在柏林墙倒塌之后。

sentences.en: Hundertwasser died in 2000,
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦于2000年逝世，

sentences.en: while at sea on the QE2.
sentences.zh: 当时正在伊丽莎白女王二号邮轮的海上。

sentences.en: The Green Citadel was completed five years later.
sentences.zh: 五年后，绿堡完工。

sentences.en: 80% of the Green Citadel is covered in grass.
sentences.zh: 绿堡百分之八十的面积被草覆盖。

sentences.en: And the building has what Hundertwasser called tree tenets,
sentences.zh: 这座建筑拥有亨德泽瓦所说的树木租户，

sentences.en: trees that were planted into special rooms inside of people's apartments.
sentences.zh: 种植在人们公寓内部特殊房间里的树木。

sentences.en: And his ideas about how to incorporate flora into buildings
sentences.zh: 他关于如何将植物融入建筑的想法

sentences.en: didn't stop with plants and trees.
sentences.zh: 并不止于植物和树木。

sentences.en: Hundertwasser was also really into mold,
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦还非常喜欢霉菌，

sentences.en: like the kind of mold that grows in the back of the fridge.
sentences.zh: 比如冰箱后面长的那种霉菌。

sentences.en: When a wall grows moldy,
sentences.zh: 当一面墙长了霉，

sentences.en: and the mold exhibits unusual patterns,
sentences.zh: 而且霉菌呈现出不寻常的图案，

sentences.en: or when moss grows over the geometric angus of a corner of your house,
sentences.zh: 或者当苔藓长过你房子拐角的几何锐角时，

sentences.en: together with mushrooms and vegetation,
sentences.zh: 伴随着蘑菇和植被，

sentences.en: life moves into a sterile house.
sentences.zh: 生命就搬进了一座死气沉沉的房子。

sentences.en: And as delightful as Hundertwasser's warped and kaleidoscopic buildings are,
sentences.zh: 尽管亨德泽瓦那些扭曲且万花筒般的建筑令人愉悦，

sentences.en: the exaltation of mold is where he and I part ways.
sentences.zh: 但对霉菌的崇拜却是我和他分道扬镳的地方。

sentences.en: At least we know he didn't suffer from allergies.
sentences.zh: 至少我们知道他没有过敏症。

sentences.en: Instead of TV, it is better to watch nature grow wild
sentences.zh: 与其看电视，不如看着大自然野蛮生长

sentences.en: and grow out of human control.
sentences.zh: 并长出人类的控制范围之外。

sentences.en: For instance, in the case of spontaneous vegetation.
sentences.zh: 例如，自发植被的情况。

sentences.en: Oh boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Hundertwasser was big on manifestos.
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦非常热衷于宣言。

sentences.en: He had another one that he called,
sentences.zh: 他还有另一个宣言，他称之为，

sentences.en: and I'm not making this up,
sentences.zh: 我可不是在瞎编，

sentences.en: the Holy S*** Manifesto.
sentences.zh: 《圣屎宣言》。

sentences.en: Every time we use the flush toilet,
sentences.zh: 每次我们使用抽水马桶时，

sentences.en: we think it is a hygienic accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 我们都认为这是一项卫生成就。

sentences.en: But in fact, we violate the laws of nature.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，我们违反了自然规律。

sentences.en: We pray before we eat and we say grace afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我们在饭前祈祷，饭后感恩。

sentences.en: But we do not pray when we s***.
sentences.zh: 但我们在拉屎时并不祈祷。

sentences.en: Everything taking humans away from nature,
sentences.zh: 任何把人类带离自然的事物，

sentences.en: or any of our, you know, natural processes,
sentences.zh: 或者我们的任何，你知道的，自然过程，

sentences.en: was an affront to Hunter Wasser.
sentences.zh: 对亨德泽瓦来说都是一种侮辱。

sentences.en: So his buildings were designed to keep us more in touch
sentences.zh: 所以他的建筑旨在让我们更多地接触

sentences.en: with our disgusting organic reality.
sentences.zh: 我们恶心的有机现实。

sentences.en: Humus is the part of the soil that's rich and dark with organic matter.
sentences.zh: 腐殖质是土壤中富含深色有机质的部分。

sentences.en: Hunatwasser had proposed to plant natural urine purification systems
sentences.zh: 亨德泽瓦曾提议在他的建筑中种植天然尿液净化系统

sentences.en: and compost toilets in his buildings.
sentences.zh: 和堆肥厕所。

sentences.en: Although his investors wouldn't back indoor compost toilets in the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的投资者不愿意在绿堡里支持室内堆肥厕所。

sentences.en: When Luisa was last in Germany, she talked her way into the building.
sentences.zh: 当路易莎上次去德国时，她想方设法混进了那栋建筑。

sentences.en: This is the shower that he put in.
sentences.zh: 这是他装的淋浴间。

sentences.en: For the bathroom, they use blue tiles as a rim.
sentences.zh: 对于浴室，他们用蓝色的瓷砖作为边框。

sentences.en: And also, there's no straight lines here either.
sentences.zh: 而且这里也没有一条直线。

sentences.en: Oh, none.
sentences.zh: 哦，完全没有。

sentences.en: None.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I visited a bathroom in the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 我参观了绿色城堡里的一个浴室。

sentences.en: I didn't see any composting toilets.
sentences.zh: 我没看到任何堆肥厕所。

sentences.en: I didn't even see any mold.
sentences.zh: 我甚至连一点霉菌都没看到。

sentences.en: What I did see, though, were crazy patterns.
sentences.zh: 不过，我看到的是疯狂的图案。

sentences.en: If you look at this, you have, like, round corners all over the apartment.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这个，公寓里到处都是圆角。

sentences.en: There are no, like, sharp and crisp corners here.
sentences.zh: 这里没有什么尖锐的直角。

sentences.en: Nicole Zanda and her partner Sebastian live in the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 妮可·赞达和她的伴侣塞巴斯蒂安住在绿色城堡里。

sentences.en: Like you said, we have two bathrooms,
sentences.zh: 就像你说的，我们有两个浴室，

sentences.en: one with a tub and one with a, just a shower.
sentences.zh: 一个带浴缸，另一个只有淋浴。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The bathroom tiles are staggered and slightly shifted sideways
sentences.zh: 浴室的瓷砖是错落且稍微向侧面移位的

sentences.en: so that they don't line up in columns.
sentences.zh: 这样它们就不会对齐成列。

sentences.en: In some places, they're tilted diagonally or shattered
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，它们斜着贴或者被打碎

sentences.en: and their fragments put back together to form a unique mosaic-like pattern.
sentences.zh: 碎片被重新拼凑在一起，形成独特的马赛克般图案。

sentences.en: They showed me around their place.
sentences.zh: 他们带我参观了他们的住所。

sentences.en: And you see, this is a different kind of window.
sentences.zh: 你看，这是一种不同寻常的窗户。

sentences.en: It opens up all the way and it's got that round on top of it.
sentences.zh: 它可以完全打开，顶部是圆形的。

sentences.en: Now we'll get into the parts of Hunter Vosser's manifesto-laden worldview
sentences.zh: 现在我们要进入亨德森·沃瑟充满宣言的世界观的部分

sentences.en: that is blissfully free of mold and excrement
sentences.zh: 那是一个幸福地没有霉菌和排泄物

sentences.en: and appeals to our sense of individuality.
sentences.zh: 并且迎合了我们个性意识的地方。

sentences.en: For Hunda Dvasa, the goal was to construct a creative lifestyle
sentences.zh: 对亨德森·沃瑟来说，目标是为生活和工作在绿色城堡内外的居民

sentences.en: for the people who lived and worked in and around the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 构建一种富有创造力的生活方式。

sentences.en: He designed the building to encourage residents' individuality to shine forth.
sentences.zh: 他设计这座建筑是为了鼓励居民的个性大放异彩。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just in terms of how he built the Green Citadel.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅体现在他建造绿色城堡的方式上。

sentences.en: Part of it were the rules that governed it.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分还包括管理它的规则。

sentences.en: The apartment house tenant must have the freedom
sentences.zh: 公寓大楼的租户必须享有自由

sentences.en: to lean out of his window
sentences.zh: 把身子探出窗外

sentences.en: and as far as his arms can reach
sentences.zh: 只要手臂能够伸及的地方

sentences.en: to change the outside walls of his building.
sentences.zh: 去改变他建筑的外墙。

sentences.en: Hunter Vosser encouraged residents to lean out of their windows
sentences.zh: 亨德森·沃瑟鼓励居民探出窗外

sentences.en: and paint the facade around them any color and design they wanted.
sentences.zh: 把他们周围的外墙漆成他们想要的任何颜色和设计。

sentences.en: He called this concept Fensterrecht, or right of window.
sentences.zh: 他将这个概念称为“窗户权”（Fensterrecht）。

sentences.en: He must be allowed to paint or transform his outside walls,
sentences.zh: 他必须被允许粉刷或改造他的外墙，

sentences.en: his skin as far as his arms can reach,
sentences.zh: 也就是他手臂所能及的“第二皮肤”，

sentences.en: so that from far away from the street everyone can see
sentences.zh: 以便从街道远处每个人都能看到

sentences.en: there lives a man who distinguishes himself from his neighbors
sentences.zh: 这里住着一个与他的邻居

sentences.en: and the other prisoners.
sentences.zh: 以及其他囚犯不同的人。

sentences.en: When he says prisoners, he's referring to you and me.
sentences.zh: 当他说囚犯时，他指的是你和我。

sentences.en: The idea was clothes are your second skin,
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，衣服是你的第二层皮肤，

sentences.en: your home is your third skin.
sentences.zh: 你的家是你的第三层皮肤。

sentences.en: And if we choose our own clothes,
sentences.zh: 既然我们选择自己的衣服，

sentences.en: why shouldn't renters choose the colors for their outside walls,
sentences.zh: 为什么租户不能为外墙选择颜色，

sentences.en: at least around the window?
sentences.zh: 至少在窗户周围？

sentences.en: Hunter Vosser believed that residents painting their windows,
sentences.zh: 亨德森·沃瑟认为居民粉刷窗户

sentences.en: their homes, would be a form of their own self-expression.
sentences.zh: 也就是他们的家，将是他们自我表达的一种形式。

sentences.en: He wasn't explicitly demanding that residents lean out their windows
sentences.zh: 他并不是明确要求居民探出窗外

sentences.en: and paint the borders around them,
sentences.zh: 并粉刷他们周围的边界，

sentences.en: but he was hoping to design an environment
sentences.zh: 而是希望设计一个环境

sentences.en: that would encourage them to do it of their own free will.
sentences.zh: 能够鼓励他们出于自己的自由意志去做这件事。

sentences.en: I asked Sebastian and Nicole, the Green Citadel residents,
sentences.zh: 我问塞巴斯蒂安和妮可——绿色城堡的居民，

sentences.en: if they thought about taking him up on his right of window idea.
sentences.zh: 他们是否考虑过接受他关于窗户权的想法。

sentences.en: We didn't, but technically the right is there, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们没有，但从技术上讲权利是存在的，是的。

sentences.en: Let's say hanging out the fourth floor of your window
sentences.zh: 比方说把身子挂在四楼的窗户外

sentences.en: to try to change something.
sentences.zh: 试图去改变点什么。

sentences.en: I'm not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 我可不会那么做。

sentences.en: I'm having a hard time cleaning the windows.
sentences.zh: 我连擦窗户都觉得费劲呢。

sentences.en: So far, only one person has taken Hunter Vosser ab
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，只有一个人接受了亨德森·沃瑟

sentences.en: on the right of window here,
sentences.zh: 关于这里的窗户权的提议，

sentences.en: and the modifications were pretty minor.
sentences.zh: 而且修改的地方非常微小。

sentences.en: And now residents need to apply to claim their Fensterreicht.
sentences.zh: 现在居民需要申请来行使他们的窗户权。

sentences.en: The building manager told me that he hasn't received
sentences.zh: 物业经理告诉我，他还没有收到

sentences.en: a single application from anyone else
sentences.zh: 来自其他人的哪怕一份申请

sentences.en: requesting to paint the exterior facade around their window
sentences.zh: 要求粉刷窗户周围的外立面

sentences.en: to exercise their Fensterreicht.
sentences.zh: 来行使他们的窗户权。

sentences.en: We took a quick poll here in the office,
sentences.zh: 我们在办公室里做了一个快速民意调查，

sentences.en: and both Sam and I would feel a little too intimidated
sentences.zh: 我和萨姆都觉得有点太不好意思了

sentences.en: to haphazardly paint the outside of our window
sentences.zh: 在一栋已经很惊艳的建筑上

sentences.en: on an already amazing building.
sentences.zh: 随心所欲地粉刷窗户外墙。

sentences.en: Avery would be leaning outside to paint on day one,
sentences.zh: 艾弗里第一天就会探出外面去粉刷，

sentences.en: and Katie would be out there on a window washer's rig
sentences.zh: 而凯蒂会在擦窗工的吊篮上

sentences.en: painting up a storm in a hot minute.
sentences.zh: 马上风风火火地干起来。

sentences.en: I generally love the right of window idea,
sentences.zh: 我总体上很喜欢窗户权这个想法，

sentences.en: even if I wouldn't necessarily participate,
sentences.zh: 即使我未必会亲自参与，

sentences.en: but it also feels a little like forced fun.
sentences.zh: 但它也让人觉得有点像是强行制造的快乐。

sentences.en: Like being required to take a day off of work
sentences.zh: 就像被要求请一天假

sentences.en: to play wacky games with your co-workers
sentences.zh: 在公司静修时和同事们

sentences.en: on a company retreat,
sentences.zh: 玩一些古怪的游戏，

sentences.en: or audience participation at schtick dinner theater,
sentences.zh: 或者在滑稽晚餐剧场里与观众互动，

sentences.en: or having a pop album appear automatically on your phone.
sentences.zh: 或者手机上自动出现一张流行专辑。

sentences.en: It's mainly fun for people designing the experience.
sentences.zh: 这主要是为了设计这种体验的人带来快乐。

sentences.en: That's the irony in all of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切中的讽刺之处。

sentences.en: Hundet Vasa fought against architectural doctrines
sentences.zh: 亨德森·沃瑟反对建筑教条

sentences.en: so that people could be free to express themselves,
sentences.zh: 是为了让人们能够自由地表达自己，

sentences.en: but only as he wanted them to.
sentences.zh: 但只能按他希望的方式去表达。

sentences.en: In many ways, in addition to being brilliant objects of art,
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，除了作为杰出的艺术品之外，

sentences.en: Hunter Vasa's buildings were like concept cars,
sentences.zh: 亨德森·沃瑟的建筑就像概念车

sentences.en: or high fashion.
sentences.zh: 或高级时装。

sentences.en: A three-wheeled car with a bubble roof
sentences.zh: 带有泡泡车顶的三轮汽车

sentences.en: or six-foot-tall fur hats
sentences.zh: 或是六英尺高的皮草帽子

sentences.en: are not meant for the mass market,
sentences.zh: 并不是为大众市场准备的，

sentences.en: but radical concepts move the norm forward.
sentences.zh: 但激进的概念推动了规范向前发展。

sentences.en: You certainly do not want a house full of mold.
sentences.zh: 你当然不想要一栋长满霉菌的房子。

sentences.en: You really don't.
sentences.zh: 你真的不想要。

sentences.en: It's terrible.
sentences.zh: 那太糟糕了。

sentences.en: But just try to find an urbanist these days
sentences.zh: 但你现在只要去找一个城市规划师

sentences.en: who is not all for green roofs.
sentences.zh: 他不可能不支持绿化屋顶。

sentences.en: And that's what the big, talking,
sentences.zh: 这就是那些满嘴大道理、

sentences.en: naked, speech-giving manifesto writers of the world are for.
sentences.zh: 光着身子发表宣言的世界大人物们的用处。

sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》本周由路易莎·贝克制作

sentences.zh: 合作者包括艾弗里·特拉夫曼、萨姆·格林斯潘、

sentences.zh: 凯蒂·明格，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.zh: 我们是91.7频道的项目，

sentences.zh: 并在加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的市中心制作，

sentences.zh: 工作室设在ArcSign办公室，

sentences.zh: 我想作为对东欧、

sentences.zh: 苏联区块风格建筑的一种反应，

sentences.en: this makes a lot of sense when you look at it.

sentences.zh: 我会希望看到这成为常态吗？

sentences.en: Probably not,
sentences.zh: 可能不会，

sentences.en: but I think it's always healthy to have a variety of things.
sentences.zh: 但我认为拥有多样化的事物总是健康的。

sentences.en: This is about a city who has the foresight to say,
sentences.zh: 这是关于一个有远见的城市，它敢于说：

sentences.en: yeah, these art pieces as architecture are important.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些作为建筑的艺术品是很重要的。

sentences.en: I shudder to think at the number of little mistakes
sentences.zh: 一想到如果我们没有亚当和丹尼尔

sentences.en: we would make if we didn't have Adam and Daniel
sentences.zh: 以及坐在我们身边的

sentences.en: right next to us to answer our questions.
